ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage concentrated at the margins and as localized mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white clusters located at both distal tips; a distinct geometric white mark shaped like an inverted 'V' on the lower-center region of the right lobe; sparse white punctate spots distributed across the dark field of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous sequence of low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations along the trailing edge; distal tips show increased amplitude and irregular jaggedness compared to the medial sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature following a semi-elliptical path from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixels at the extreme distal tips, indicating localized surface disruptions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of at least four distinct linear pixel disruptions on the right lobe; three horizontal and one diagonal, cutting through the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged irregular edging at the distal tips; a prominent white angular scar resembling the letter 'A' or an inverted 'V' on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The inverted 'V' shaped white mark on the right lobe provides a unique high-contrast identifier against the dark background.
